summary: Basal 0-13 cm (5-6 mm, form not recorded, 1F) under DH(FC) 13-35 cm (1F-), a 28 cm RGxf layer 35-63 cm (P), a thin SH(FC) 'problematic layer' 63-65 cm (4F; CT12 SP at 63 cm), FC 65-83 (1F), a thin K crust at 83-84 cm and 11 cm of PP/DF on top (CT1 SC at 85 cm); CT12 SC at 10 cm; HS 95 cm; E aspect, 5 deg ski-area pit
reading_issues: Hardness bars, boundaries and temperature dots measured from pixels (the SnowPilot logo overlays the left end of the 83-84 cm crust bar, whose edge is at the K tick). The basal 0-13 cm layer has size 5-6 mm but no grain-form glyph, so grain is null (flagged uncertain). Glyph readings: filled circle with flat top read as RGxf; '◎◎' read as MFcr. The CT12 SP failure at 63 cm is at the base of the 63-65 cm SH(FC) layer; layer_grain is given as that SH layer rather than the RGxf layer below. CT1 SC at 85 cm is 1 cm above the top of the 83-84 crust, inside the PP/DF layer. The CT12 SC at 10 cm is in the basal layer with blank form (layer_grain null). Field is a ski-area pit on a 5 deg E slope (per header), not a flat plot.
